name: Decimal sum
description: You are given an array of integer numbers. Calculate the sum of its elements.
input_specification: The first line of the input contains an integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 100 ) — the size of the array. Next n lines contain the elements of the array, one per line. Each element is an integer between 1 and 100 , inclusive.
output_specification: Output the sum of the elements of the array.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
